issue.title: Failure-retained real-Obsidian e2e scratch fills athena's 32G /tmp tmpfs and breaks xvfb-run

task_type_fields.impact:
Every real-Obsidian acceptance run on athena (Xvfb display lock, snap Obsidian's
private /tmp) fails before startup once the tmpfs fills, which looks like a product
NO-GO and burns agent runs. Retained failure scratch should live on disk-backed
storage with bounded retention (or opt-in `--keep-scratch`), and the docs should tell
agents to point TMPDIR at disk for cargo targets and ad hoc harnesses. Deleting the
existing /tmp leftovers belongs to Bryan or a gated cleanup, not an agent sweep.
task_type_fields.location: bob-plugins scripts/obsidian-home-cards-e2e.cjs:1062 (and the successful-only rmSync in cabinets/card-foot/intention-card/property-editor e2e runners); athena /tmp tmpfs
task_type_fields.repro:
## Repro

On athena, `df -h /tmp` reports the 32G tmpfs at 100% (21M free on 2026-11-27).
`xvfb-run -a` then cannot write `/tmp/.X<n>-lock`, so every real-Obsidian e2e run
aborts before Obsidian opens: the bob-cli-qi landing chain lost about ten runs to
NO-GO 1/76 reports with zero screenshots before the cause was found.

Largest consumers (`command du -xs /tmp/* | sort -rn`):

- `bob-settings-acceptance-*`: 11 dirs, about 1 GB each (ad hoc agent harnesses,
  bob-cli-q5.5.1 / bob-cli-qp.7 era)
- `bob-cli-dirty-q5-build`, `bob-cli-clean-q5-build`: 3.4 GB each (cargo targets)
- `bob-home-cards-*`: 21 dirs, 0.9 GB (scripts/obsidian-home-cards-e2e.cjs)
- `bob-bank-*`, `bob-pl912-*` profiles and vaults: several GB
- about 500 `.com.google.Chrome.*` files (162 KB each)

Root cause in bob-plugins: runners that keep scratch on failure for diagnosis
(`obsidian-home-cards-e2e.cjs:1062` `if (report.pass) fs.rmSync(scratch)`; the
same `successful &&` pattern in `obsidian-cabinets-e2e.cjs:854`,
`obsidian-card-foot-e2e.cjs:983`, `obsidian-intention-card-e2e.cjs:469`,
`obsidian-property-editor-e2e.cjs:972`) create that scratch under `os.tmpdir()`,
which defaults to the tmpfs, and nothing prunes it. The home-cards runner fails
every run on its bob-cli-qr baseline, so each run leaks 35-45 MB. The takeover
runner (`obsidian-frontmatter-takeover-e2e.cjs:2644`) always cleans up and was
verified to leave nothing behind over five runs.

issue.creation_reason: Found by the bob-cli-qi land agent: a full /tmp made xvfb-run fail before Obsidian started, which stalled the previous bob-cli-qi landing chain for about ten NO-GO runs; not caused by bob-cli-qi.

evidence.note: Independent repro from bob-cli-q5.6.1 land (also proposed by bob-cli-q5.6.1.2 note #1: 6 bob-plugins e2e self-tests ENOSPC on a full /tmp, identical on clean base). On 2026-11-27 df /tmp = 32G tmpfs 100% (19M free). Full bob-plugins npm test with TMPDIR pointed at disk still failed obsidian-block-marks-e2e --self-test with ENOSPC copying task-status-cycler/main.js into /tmp/bm-e2e/self-*: scripts/obsidian-block-marks-e2e-lib.cjs scratchRoot() hardcodes /tmp/bm-e2e (deliberately, for Chromium SingletonSocket sun_path length), so the TMPDIR workaround cannot rescue that runner once the tmpfs fills. Remediation should keep a short socket-safe path that is not the shared tmpfs, or prune it.

payload.description: Candidate duplicate for ENOSPC e2e self-test failures

evidence.note: bob-cli-qm landing (proposed by bob-cli-qm.7--1 note #5, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP): on athena 2026-11-27 df -h /tmp shows the 32G tmpfs at 100% (11M free). qm.7--1 saw scripts/obsidian-block-marks-e2e.cjs --self-test fail ENOSPC writing its hardcoded /tmp/bm-e2e, which is the only failure in a full bob-plugins npm test on 56baeb9f (10263 pass / 1 fail / 4 skip). That adds one more runner to this bead's list: the block-marks runner ignores TMPDIR entirely, and the other runners' retained failure scratch ignores it too. Same root cause and remediation (disk-backed scratch with bounded retention, honor TMPDIR). Deleting the existing leftovers stays with Bryan.

Independent repro from bob-cli-qp.7 (Ref Cards acceptance, proposed in its note #5, triaged by bob-cli-qp.land): on athena 2026-11-27 ~05:00Z the /tmp tmpfs was 100% full (leftovers /tmp/bob-settings-acceptance-*, /tmp/bob-cli-{clean,dirty}-q5-build, /tmp/bob-bank-editor-routing-*), so Xvfb could not compile its keymap and xvfb-run real-Obsidian e2e runs failed before Obsidian opened. The qp.7 run only succeeded by wrapping the runner in unshare -Urm with a disk-backed /tmp bind mount. Impact: every real-Obsidian acceptance on athena reads as a startup NO-GO until /tmp is pruned or runners keep scratch on disk.
